meta.name: liveflow
meta.description: Consolidate a multi-entity ledger (QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, or any per-entity JSON) into one close, reconcile it against a golden reference, catch mis-keyed entries that cross-foots miss, and gate on "shippable without review?" before numbers go to a board, investor, lender, or downstream report. Use for month/quarter close, multi-entity roll-ups, or any time figures from more than one accounting source must agree before they are trusted.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 合并多实体账目并核对差异
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每月需要合并多家公司的财务数据并确保准确。
copy.tagline_en: Consolidate multi-entity ledgers and reconcile discrepancies
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to consolidate financial data from multiple entities and ensure accuracy before reporting.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能合并多个会计系统的账目，与标准数据核对，找出记错科目的条目，并判断数据是否可直接用于报告。
howto.when: 当你要合并多个实体（如 QuickBooks、Xero 等）的账目，或进行月/季/年结账时，可以触发。

say.text: 帮我合并 QuickBooks 和 Xero 的 Q3 账目并核对。
say.note: Claude 会执行合并与核对流程。

say.text: 检查 NetSuite 账目中是否有记错科目的条目。
say.note: Claude 会找出分类错误的条目。

say.text: 判断当前合并结果是否无需审核即可交付。
say.note: Claude 会给出“是”或“否”的结论。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can consolidate ledgers from multiple accounting systems, reconcile against a golden reference, catch mis-categorized entries, and gate whether the numbers are shippable without review.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to consolidate multi-entity ledgers (e.g., QuickBooks, Xero) or perform month/quarter/year-end close.

say_en.text: Consolidate and reconcile Q3 ledgers from QuickBooks and Xero.
say_en.note: Claude runs the consolidation and reconciliation.
Claude identifies entries booked to wrong categories.

say_en.text: Is the consolidation shippable without review?
say_en.note: Claude outputs yes or no based on the gate.
